PAGE TITLE: SECTION 1 Management's Discussion and Analysis

PHOTOS: A 3D printer creating a NASA insignia out of green powder (GRX-810 superalloy) under a laser.
PHOTO CREDIT: NASA/Jordan Salkin, May 11, 2024

KEY FACTS:
- NASA is licensing its invention GRX-810 to four American companies.
- GRX-810 is a 3D-printable high-temperature material for stronger, more durable airplane and spacecraft parts.
